public_source_basis.claim_used: DVOL is a forward-looking 30-day implied-volatility action gauge; it supplies regime, not direction.
public_source_basis.claim_used_2: Perpetual premium/funding tether the perpetual to spot; open interest measures outstanding leveraged contracts.

mechanism.claim: During an elevated Deribit DVOL regime, a large completed eight-hour Binance premium-index displacement accompanied by a net contraction in perpetual open interest identifies directional basis pressure produced while leveraged inventory is being closed rather than newly sponsored. Fade the completed premium displacement for one eight-hour inventory cycle.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of the completed eight-hour premium-index close-minus-open displacement
mechanism.why_distinct: OIFAR fades a one-hour BTC price shock after joint BVOL/DVOL body expansion and an extreme OI flush. OCDR uses DVOL body leadership, rising OI, and extreme funding. OPDR follows an efficient one-hour premium move under a BVOL/DVOL level spread. HVPOIUR uses no BTC price, BVOL, funding, prior event set, or prior control: it combines a DVOL level regime with an eight-hour premium displacement and net OI contraction.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: DVOL must occupy its causal upper 40%, while the absolute premium displacement must occupy its causal upper 40%.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed daily derivatives-only decision boundaries and no BTC path input are absent from Gross9 clocks.

features.premium_block: 480 exact unique bars_binance_premium BTCUSDT 1m rows in [D-8h,D); displacement=last close-first open; finite and strict nonzero
features.open_interest_block: 96 exact unique open_interest_binance BTCUSDT period=5m rows in [D-8h,D); log(last/first)<0; finite positive endpoints
features.dvol_regime: the exact completed DVOL hour ending D; positive close
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks over at most 270 source-valid boundaries, minimum 180; current excluded
features.eligibility: abs(premium displacement) rank>=0.60, DVOL close rank>=0.60, and net OI change<0
features.availability: D after every constituent source row is complete

clock.reservation: fixed nonoverlapping boundaries; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after novelty passes
clock.rv20: not a signal input; q90 audit only after all economic stages pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure: source, novelty, train, test, eval, final; no threshold, side, hold, clock, subset, source, or control repair.
